judgments.reason: The focal transcript explicitly states the winner pays the bid and then receives a three-coin commission, and also that a bid cannot exceed your coins; it never articulates a mechanism where the commission is applied before payment allowing bids above available coins.

The transcript treats sealed rival bids as private and does not claim or demonstrate that waiting reveals already-committed rival bid values before the focal player's commitment; no mechanism or observed outcome supporting this is articulated.

The focal play closed only after all three lots were sold and the model restates the rule that close settles after all three lots are sold; it does not articulate or show early settlement with unsold lots.
The transcript distinguishes catalog purchases from auction wins and never claims catalog buys receive the three-coin auction commission; no mechanism or observed discrepancy is described.
